jobs.descriptionText: About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. About the Team Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. In this role you will be part of the Product Design team, which is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about. What You'll Do As a Product Design Intern, you will focus on designing and building experiences that will be shipped to our users in production. You will contribute design iterations to ongoing project workstreams, tackling important projects to increase global commerce, and help shape brand new experiences. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. Key responsibilities include: Work on a product design project with a product team, translating business ideas into real experience. Help craft thoughtful experiences that enable startups and large businesses to establish and manage their businesses. Apply problem-solving skills and human-centered approaches to address complex and ambiguous business and user problems. Develop and refine design solutions by partnering closely with other designers. Craft and prototype visually polished experiences to get user feedback. Partner closely with engineering to implement a feature/product from design to implementation, and get it in the hands of our users. Engage in group design critiques and collaborative design sessions to improve and receive feedback on your work. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, data scientists, and researchers, proactively seeking and incorporating feedback. Understand and advocate for our users, participating in the design process from early concepts to final delivery. Who You Are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a design-related field, such as UX/UI, Interaction Design, Human Interface, Computer Science, HCI, or a related discipline. Some experience using computer programs to design, such as Figma/Canva. Demonstrated experience designing experiences and user flows. Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and best practices. Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, form an understanding through independent research, and effectively work with a mentor and teammates. Are a self-motivated problem solver committed to personal growth. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Proven ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate work while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs. Ability to participate in a paid full-time internship between May–August, 2027. Preferred Qualifications (A bonus, not a requirement) Previous project, internship, or work experience in UX/UI design or related fields. Experience working with or conducting your own research, presenting results, and acting on those results. Experience with AI tools like Cursor, Lovable, V0, or any others. Strong knowledge in design craft and visual design. Intent to return to the degree program after the completion of the internship/co-op.

jobs.title: Product Designer, Treasury
jobs.descriptionText: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Product Designers at Stripe are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management. Together, we define user-facing experiences, then translate that thinking into complete products that can be tested, shipped, and refined. We’re responsible for creating powerful, well-crafted, beautiful products that users love and are eager to recommend to others. Treasury brings business banking and payments together on Stripe. We help businesses receive, store, send, and spend their money in one place — with faster access to funds, global money movement, and cards for everyday spending. Instead of stitching together banks, payment processors, and financial tools, businesses can manage their money where they already run their payments. Our ambition is to make managing business finances feel as intuitive and thoughtfully designed as the best consumer products. That means making sophisticated capabilities accessible, bringing clarity to complex workflows, and paying close attention to the details that help people feel confident and in control of their money. What you’ll do As a Product Designer on the Treasury team, you’ll help rethink an essential part of running a business. Your work could help businesses access their earnings sooner, understand their cash flow, move money across currencies and borders, or manage everyday spending — all within a connected experience on Stripe. You’ll work across new and existing products, shaping zero-to-one experiences and refining the details of what’s already in users’ hands. You’ll partner closely with Product and Engineering to define problems, explore possibilities, and bring high-quality experiences to life. This work involves substantial ambiguity and technical and regulatory complexity; your role is to make the experience feel simple without losing the rigor that financial products demand. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end product design process, from understanding user needs and defining problems through prototyping, detailed design, launch, and iteration. Design intuitive, cohesive experiences that help businesses receive, store, send, and spend money with confidence. Bring clarity to ambiguous problems, using research, exploration, and prototypes to establish direction and turn early ideas into products people can use. Deliver exceptional interaction and visual design, bringing a consumer-grade standard of usability, polish, and care to complex financial tools. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap around meaningful, measurable user outcomes. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and other stakeholders to understand constraints and find thoughtful solutions that protect users without introducing unnecessary friction. Work with user researchers, content designers, and other product designers to validate ideas and create a consistent experience across Treasury and the broader Stripe Dashboard. Work closely with engineers through implementation, refining interactions and details so the shipped experience meets the intended quality bar. Share work regularly in design reviews, explain your decisions clearly, and use feedback to strengthen your work. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Have 6+ years of relevant product design experience at a technology, product-driven company. Have strong visual design, interaction design, and prototyping skills, demonstrated through shipped experiences with a high bar for craft and usability. Can make complex products feel simple and approachable, with thoughtful information hierarchy, clear interactions, and meticulous attention to detail. Are comfortable working through substantial ambiguity: defining problems, exploring alternatives, and making progress when requirements are incomplete or evolving. Can engage deeply with technical and regulatory requirements, working with cross-functional partners to translate constraints into clear, trustworthy user experiences. Have worked autonomously on substantial product initiatives, partnering with Product and Engineering to shape both direction and execution. Have experience working with and contributing to an established design system, balancing consistency with the needs of new experiences. Have experience collaborating closely with engineers to deliver high-quality interfaces. Communicate your thinking clearly through prototypes, user flows, and design rationale, and actively seek feedback. Can prioritize effectively across projects at different stages, balancing speed, scope, and quality. Preferred qualifications Experience shaping zero-to-one products, from early exploration through launch. Experience designing financial products, particularly business accounts, money management, payments, or spending tools. Experience designing consumer products, or bringing a comparable standard of simplicity and craft to complex business software. Experience connecting fragmented tools or workflows into a cohesive product experience. Enjoy collaborating with other designers, sharing feedback, and helping one another grow.
